title: Create a board based on filters
content:
Jira allows you to create a company-managed board that displays work items from multiple spaces. Before you begin, you must have access to at least one saved work item filter — either your own filter, or one that someone else has shared with you. If you don't, you need to create and save a new work item filter first. More about creating a filter using JQL.
If you're working with a team-managed project, this is the required method for creating additional boards. Team-managed projects don't support creating extra boards directly from within the project.
To create a board from an existing filter:
- From the top navigation at the top of the page, select the search field (or press / ) and select Go to all: Boards. Then select Create board in the upper right of the screen.
- In the modal that appears, choose to either Create a Scrum board or Create a Kanban board, then choose Board from an existing Saved Filter.
- Give your board a name, and choose which filter you want to use. This new board will be available to all users who have access to your chosen filter.
- When you’re ready, select Create board.
Another way you can create a board using an existing filter is by:
- Hover your cursor over the company-managed software space in the sidebar until a plus icon () shows up next to the space name.
- Select Create board (), then select what type of board you’d like to create.
- Enter a name for your board.
- Choose what to include in the board from the dropdown, then select Advanced.
- Select which saved filter you’d like to use from the dropdown.
- Select Create.
Your new board is now ready to use!
